conf.description: Infoblox NIOS DDI - dns-query (named combined query/response log), syslog-leef format. Same shape as the CEF sibling with the LEEF header/attribute grammar and its two renamed keys (srcPort, url).

conf.comment: infoblox-ddi / dns-query / syslog-leef. Same two hazards as the CEF sibling: InfobloxDNSQFlags collides between Query Flags and Response Flags (both captured, kept separate), and the answer RR set inside msg can contain '=' and spaces (TXT rdata), parsed with a dedicated code step. LEEF differs from CEF in exactly two key names: srcPort (not spt) -> source.port, url (not destinationDnsDomain) -> dns.question.name. Never routed through the stock integration's BIND-grammar pipeline_dns. 'Timestamp' names no literal LEEF key, so _time uses the syslog header instead - see README gap.

explode the LEEF key=value attributes (src, srcPort, dst, dest_port, InfobloxDNSView, url, InfobloxDNSQClass, InfobloxDNSQType, proto, InfobloxDNSRCode, transaction_id, opcode, and a first pass at msg/InfobloxDNSQFlags which the next two steps correct)
capture the full msg attribute value (answer RR set) to end of line
